text: When one door closes, another opens; but we often look so long and so regretfully upon the closed door that we do not see the one which has opened for us.
author: Alexander Graham Bell

text: Some of us think holding on makes us strong; but sometimes it is letting go.
author: Hermann Hesse

text: If you love someone, set them free. If they come back they're yours; if they don't they never were.
author: Richard Bach

text: Don't cry because it's over. Smile because it happened.
author: Dr. Seuss

text: 'Tis better to have loved and lost than never to have loved at all.
author: Alfred Lord Tennyson

text: I don't think breakups are ever easy for anybody. If they are, they aren't much of a breakup.
author: Chris Young

text: Hair is so important and emotional. I dyed mine black and blond after a breakup - there's something really powerful about changing your hair when you're in a weird place.
author: Kate Nash

text: I just always have to cry out a breakup, and then I can make peace with it pretty quickly.
author: Brittany Murphy

text: The cure for a broken heart is self-love.
author: Jonathan Harnisch

text: The best way to mend a broken heart is time and girlfriends.
author: Gwyneth Paltrow

text: The heart will break, but broken live on.
author: Lord Byron

text: A girl doesn't need anyone who doesn't need her.
author: Marilyn Monroe

text: We are never ever, ever getting back together.
author: Taylor Swift

text: Every time your heart is broken, a doorway cracks open to a world full of new beginnings, new opportunities.
author: Patti Roberts

text: When you are in love, and you get hurt, it's like a cut—it will heal, but there will always be a scar.
author: Soo Jie

text: I'm really a very happy, contented little person in spite of my broken heart.
author: L.M. Montgomery

text: I know my heart will never be the same. But I'm telling myself I'll be okay.
author: Sara Evans

text: It's so empowering to say, 'This isn't serving me,' and walk away in peace.
author: Unknown

text: You can clutch the past so tightly to your chest that it leaves your arms too full to embrace the present.
author: Jan Glidewell

text: We too, like trees can shake off our dead leaves and begin again.
author: A.Y. Greyson

text: You get through it. It's a process that's not easy, but I get less and less sad about it every day.
author: Ryan Phillippe

text: The only way out is through.
author: Robert Frost

text: Just believe that the heartbreak was a gift in itself. Cry if you have to, but it won't be forever! You will find love again, and it will be even more beautiful! In the meantime enjoy all that YOU are!
author: Rihanna

text: You cannot prevent the birds of sorrow from flying over your head, but you can prevent them from building nests in your hair.
author: Chinese Proverb

text: The greatest win is walking away and choosing not to engage in drama and toxic energy at all.
author: Lalah Delia

text: Every time you thought you couldn't keep moving forward, you did. Take a moment to appreciate your strength.
author: Karen Salmanson

text: I was so scared of ever being alone, and I think, conquering that fear, this year, was actually bigger than any other transition that I had, this entire year.
author: Miley Cyrus

text: If you truly want to be respected by people you love, you must prove to them that you can survive without them.
author: Michael Bassey Johnson

text: Every woman that finally figured out her worth, has picked up her suitcases of pride and boarded a flight to freedom, which landed in the valley of change.
author: Shannon L. Alder

text: The truth is, unless you let go, unless you forgive yourself, unless you forgive the situation, unless you realize that the situation is over, you cannot move forward.
author: Steve Maraboli

text: Moving on is not forgetting — moving on is being able to remember without feeling awful about it.
author: Sam Madison

text: Sadness flies away on the wings of time.
author: Jean de La Fontaine

text: That's all you can do in this world, no matter how strong the current beats against you, or how heavy your burden, or how tragic your love story. You keep going.
author: Robyn Schneider

text: Whoever you are, no matter how lonely, the world offers itself to your imagination, calls to you like the wild geese, harsh and exciting – over and over announcing your place in the family of things.
author: Mary Oliver

text: I always get to where I am going by walking away from where I have been.
author: A. A. Milne

text: You can't start the next chapter of your life if you keep re-reading the last one.
author: Michael McMillian

text: A very wise man once told me that you can't look back – you just have to put the past behind you, and find something better in your future.
author: Jodi Picoult

text: I'm not sure what the future holds but I do know that I'm going to be positive and not wake up feeling desperate.
author: Nicole Kidman

text: It's hard to be clear about who you are when you are carrying around a bunch of baggage from the past. I've learned to let go and move more quickly into the next place.
author: Angelina Jolie

text: There are things that we never want to let go of, people we never want to leave behind. But keep in mind that letting go isn't the end of the world, it's the beginning of a new life.
author: Unknown

text: One taught me love. One taught me patience. And one taught me pain. Now, I'm so amazing. Say I've loved and I've lost. But that's not what I see. So, look what I got. Look what you taught me.
author: Ariana Grande

text: I'd rather love a million times and have my heart broken every time, than hold a permanently empty heart forever.
author: H.C. Paye

text: Never forget what you are. The rest of the world will not. Wear it like armor, and it can never be used to hurt you.
author: Tyrion Lannister

text: Accept yourself, love yourself, and keep moving forward. If you want to fly, you have to give up what weighs you down.
author: Roy T. Bennett

text: Whatever you do, never run back to what broke you.
author: Frank Ocean

text: So many things become beautiful when you really look.
author: Lauren Oliver

text: If my life is going to mean anything, I have to live it myself.
author: Rick Riordan

text: Someday you will wake up feeling 51 percent happy and slowly, molecule by molecule, you will feel like yourself again.
author: Amy Poehler

text: It is always important to know when something has reached its end. Closing circles, shutting doors, finishing chapters, it doesn't matter what we call it; what matters is to leave in the past those moments in life that are over.
author: Paulo Coelho

text: I promise you there is something worse out there than being sad, and that's being alone and being sad. Ain't no one in this room alone.
author: Ted Lasso

text: Don't worry. Just when you think your life is over, a new storyline falls from the sky and lands right in your lap.
author: Rebekah Crane

text: Don't be sorry, be fierce.
author: RuPaul

text: It is strange how often a heart must be broken before the years can make it wise.
author: Sara Teasdale

text: Gonna love myself, no, I don't need anybody else.
author: Hailee Steinfeld

text: Everybody has bad relationships and, at the end of the day, they are just a great way to set yourself up for a good relationship.
author: Anne Hathaway

text: Life becomes easier when you learn to accept an apology you never got.
author: Robert Brault

text: Don't change yourself so that other people will like you. Be yourself, and the right people will like you.
author: Unknown

text: We must be willing to let go of the life we planned so as to have the life that is waiting for us.
author: Joseph Campbell

text: You stop revisiting memories when you outgrow the people you made them with.
author: Nikki Rowe

text: I would rather have my heart broken a thousand times than never to love at all. I have so much love to give — I'm not empty of love, I'm full of love.
author: Cameron Diaz

text: The great courageous act that we must all do, is to have the courage to step out of our history and past so that we can live our dreams.
author: Oprah Winfrey

text: Let everything happen to you. Beauty and terror. Just keep going. No feeling is final.
author: Rainer Maria Rilke

text: If it doesn't agree with your spirit let it go.
author: Germany Kent

text: The truth is, I should be angry, resentful and disillusioned about relationships. But I'm not. Love did not work with that person. But it can work with another.
author: Eva Longoria

text: When your heart is broken, your boats are burned: nothing matters anymore. It is the end of happiness and the beginning of peace.
author: George Bernard Shaw

text: Sometimes love means letting go when you want to hold on tighter.
author: Melissa Marr

text: If you didn't love him, this never would have happened. But you did. And accepting that love and everything that followed it is part of letting it go.
author: Sarah Dessen

text: My wish for you is that you continue. Continue to be who you are, to astonish a mean world with your acts of kindness.
author: Maya Angelou

text: Someday you're gonna look back on this moment of your life as such a sweet time of grieving. You'll see that you were in mourning and your heart was broken, but your life was changing.
author: Elizabeth Gilbert

text: Happiness always looks small while you hold it in your hands, but let it go, and you learn at once how big and precious it is.
author: Maxim Gorky
source: The Lower Depths and Other Plays

text: I will not allow myself to not feel chosen every single day. And I'll wait till whenever that is.
author: Hannah Brown

text: I just wanted to listen to Taylor Swift alone.
author: Jessica Day

text: Years of love have been forgot, in the hatred of a minute.
author: Edgar Allan Poe

text: In another life, I want to be born as you and love me.
author: Brand

text: Consider how hard it is to change yourself and you'll understand what little chance you have trying to change others.
author: Unknown

text: Grief after a relationship isn't weakness. It's proof that what you had was real.
author: Unknown

text: You don't have to be okay right now. Heartbreak is one of the heaviest things a person carries. Give yourself permission to feel it.
author: Unknown

text: Crying over someone you loved isn't pathetic. It's human. It means you were brave enough to love.
author: Unknown

text: You're allowed to miss someone and still know they weren't right for you. Both things are true.
author: Unknown

text: Some losses don't have a timeline. Heal at your own pace.
author: Unknown

text: You didn't lose the love of your life. You lost someone who couldn't love you the way you deserved.
author: Unknown

text: The end of that relationship wasn't failure. It was you outgrowing something too small for you.
author: Unknown

text: Sometimes the person who leaves makes the most room for the person you were always meant to become.
author: Unknown

text: What felt like losing everything was actually you being redirected to something truer.
author: Unknown

text: Not every ending is a loss. Some are a release.
author: Unknown

text: Someone leaving you doesn't make you less lovable. It makes them the wrong person.
author: Unknown

text: You were not too much. You were too much for the wrong person.
author: Unknown

text: The way they treated you at the end doesn't erase who you were in the beginning. You were worth loving then. You still are.
author: Unknown

text: Their inability to see your value says nothing about your value.
author: Unknown

text: You deserve a love that doesn't make you question if you deserve it.
author: Unknown

text: You loved them at your fullest. That's not something to regret — that's something to be proud of.
author: Unknown

text: You showed up. You tried. You loved hard. That's not your flaw — that's your gift.
author: Unknown

text: The hardest part isn't missing them — it's missing who you were when you were with them.
author: Unknown

text: You'll have days where you reach for your phone to text them and then remember. That's okay. Grief has muscle memory too.
author: Unknown

text: One day you'll realize the silence they left behind was actually peace.
author: Unknown

text: When the dust settles, you'll see — you weren't broken by that relationship. You were shaped by it.
author: Unknown

text: Future you is healing. Present you just has to survive today.
author: Unknown

text: A year from now, you'll look back and finally understand why it had to end.
author: Unknown

text: You can wish them well and still never want to see them again. That's not cold — that's healed.
author: Unknown

text: Forgiveness isn't for them. It's so the weight of them stops living in your chest.
author: Unknown

text: I'm sorry, I wish we could've gone to the moon together.
author: David Martinez

text: Grief is the price we pay for love.
author: Queen Elizabeth II

text: Close the window that hurts you, no matter how beautiful the view is.
author: Manish Sharma

text: Never question your worth just because someone else couldn't see it.
author: Unknown

text: You can be the most beautiful shade of blue, but you'll never be enough for someone whose favorite color is red.
author: Alissa Nelson

text: Just because you love the ocean doesn't mean you have to drown in it.
author: Unknown

text: Argument only separates those who already wanted to leave.
author: Unknown

text: Letting go is an act of self-love.
author: Unknown

text: You lived before them. You'll live after.
author: Unknown

text: Some chapters have to close.
author: Unknown

text: You deserve more than almost.
author: Unknown

text: Walking away takes the most courage.
author: Unknown

text: Closure comes from within.
author: Unknown

text: Not every goodbye is a loss.
author: Unknown

text: You outgrew them. That's okay.
author: Unknown

text: Heal first. Love will find you.
author: Unknown

text: Your heart knows when it's time.
author: Unknown

text: Sometimes love means letting go.
author: Unknown

text: You can miss them and move on.
author: Unknown

text: Letting go isn't giving up.
author: Unknown

text: You chose yourself. That matters.
author: Unknown

text: Better alone than badly loved.
author: Unknown

text: The right love won't leave you broken.
author: Unknown

text: Your peace is worth more than they are.
author: Unknown

text: Not all love stories last forever.
author: Unknown

text: Release what no longer serves you.
author: Unknown

text: You are whole without them.
author: Unknown

text: Endings can be beautiful too.
author: Unknown

text: Love yourself enough to walk away.
author: Unknown

text: Some people are lessons, not forever.
author: Unknown

text: You'll bloom again.
author: Unknown

text: Broken hearts still beat.
author: Unknown

text: The best revenge is moving on.
author: Unknown

text: You are free now. Remember that.
author: Unknown
